s.n: Kingston stamp and go saltfish fritters
s.note: Crisp Jamaican salt cod fritters with spring onion, chilli and thyme, with lime
s.how: Soak 250g salt cod overnight in cold water, changing it twice, then simmer for 15 minutes, drain and flake. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and 180ml water into a thick batter and stir in the fish, 3 sliced spring onions, a chopped red chilli, a tsp of thyme, a crushed garlic clove, a diced tomato and pepper. Fry spoonfuls in oil at 180C for 3 minutes until golden, drain and serve with lime wedges.

s.note: Thin green plantain chips fried crisp, tossed with lime zest, chilli and sea salt
s.how: Peel 3 green plantains and slice them 2mm thick on a mandoline. Fry in batches in oil at 175C for 3 minutes until crisp and pale gold, drain, then toss with sea salt, a little chilli powder and the zest and juice of a lime.

m.n: Quarrel's jerk chicken with rice and peas
m.note: Chicken thighs marinated in scotch bonnet, allspice and thyme, roasted and charred, with coconut rice and kidney beans
m.how: Blitz 4 spring onions, a scotch bonnet, 4 garlic cloves, ginger, 3 tsp allspice, 2 tsp thyme, cinnamon, nutmeg, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 3 tbsp soy, a lime's juice, oil, pepper and salt to a paste and rub into 1.2kg slashed chicken thighs. Marinate at least 4 hours. Roast at 200C for 40 minutes, then char on a hot barbecue or under the grill. Simmer 400ml coconut milk and 200ml water with spring onion, garlic, allspice and thyme, add 300g rice and a tin of kidney beans and cook covered for 18 minutes. Serve with lime wedges.

w.note: Spiced coconut and brown sugar cake with a crunchy coconut top and lime whipped cream
w.how: Mix 250g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp cinnamon, half a tsp nutmeg, salt, 150g brown sugar and 100g desiccated coconut. Whisk in an egg, 250ml coconut milk, 80g melted butter and vanilla, spread in a greased 20cm square tin and scatter with demerara and shredded coconut. Bake at 180C for 35 minutes, cool and serve in squares with cream whipped with lime zest.

d.note: Dark rum, fresh lime, sugar syrup and pineapple over ice with bitters and grated nutmeg
d.how: Stir 60ml lime juice, 120ml sugar syrup, 180ml dark rum, 240ml pineapple juice and 4 dashes of bitters in a jug and chill for 30 minutes. Pour over ice, grate over nutmeg and add a lime wheel.
